HEAD e92a0720e already contains the legacy SHA-256/384/512/512-224/512-256 md_data refusal hardening committed at 5163f564f (src/evp/legacy_sha.rs): five initialisers that previously dereferenced a NULL md_data reachable through the exported EVP_MD_meth_get_init accessor now call init_md_data, refuse with 0, and write nothing. The only source/build-relevant change made for 0.0.42 is the Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock version bump; src/ is e92a0720e. The tree also carries the S'' freeze (freeze-S-double-prime.json), the v1j closure (openssh-closure-v1j.json), and the element-7 regression analysis (element7-regression-v1j.json).

non_claims: Publishing is not a safety or a compatibility result.
This release ships a real fix: every legacy SHA initialiser refuses a NULL md_data that a fresh C-valid EVP_MD_CTX legitimately has, with a canary that reproduces SIGSEGV when a guard is removed.
The openssh closure is REFUSED at 146 reachable obligations (62 discharged, 55 blocked, 29 unknown). Element 7 is NOT ESTABLISHED: the earlier PASS was an artefact of which symbol the linker kept.
Reachability is non-monotone under a one-file diff (19 of 19 changes unexplained), so historical closure counts are not like-for-like.
No full suite, probe set, SEAL instrument or independent adjudication was run at this identity.
